reviewNotes: Sample content. Every record needs review by a qualified person (trainer or physiotherapist for exercise safety, registered dietitian for food values, editor and reviewer for learn cards) before release.

strings.cue.cooldown_start.1: Almost there. Time to cool down.
strings.cue.cooldown_start.2: Last two minutes. Slow it down.
strings.cue.desk_start.1: A quick reset. Stay seated, or stand if you like.
strings.cue.easier_offer.1: Too much? You can switch to an easier version any time.
strings.cue.easier_offer.2: An easier version is one tap away.
strings.cue.harder_offer.1: Feeling strong? Try the harder version.
strings.cue.quiet_mode_on.1: Quiet mode is on. No jumping moves today.
strings.cue.resumed.1: Welcome back. Picking up where you left off.
strings.cue.session_complete.2: That is a session. Nice work.
strings.cue.session_saved.1: Saved. You can finish this later.
strings.cue.session_start.1: Let's begin. We start with a gentle warm-up.
strings.cue.session_start.2: Ready when you are. Warm-up first.
strings.cue.warmup_start.2: Two minutes to wake your body up.
strings.cue.work_start.1: Warm-up done. Now the main work.
strings.cue.work_start.2: Nice and steady. Here comes the main work.
strings.exercise.ankle_pumps.alt: A person sitting with one foot lifted, pointing and flexing the ankle.
strings.exercise.ankle_pumps.cue: Point and flex your feet to get your blood moving.
strings.exercise.ankle_pumps.name: Ankle pumps
strings.exercise.ankle_pumps.step1: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
strings.exercise.ankle_pumps.step2: Point your toes, then pull them back towards you.
strings.exercise.arm_circles.alt: A person standing with both arms stretched out to the sides, drawing circles.
strings.exercise.arm_circles.cue: Draw big, slow circles with your arms.
strings.exercise.arm_circles.name: Arm circles
strings.exercise.arm_circles.step1: Stand tall and lift both arms out to the sides.
strings.exercise.arm_circles.step2: Draw small circles, then make them bigger.
strings.exercise.bicycle_crunch.alt: A person on their back bringing one elbow towards the opposite knee.
strings.exercise.bicycle_crunch.cue: Bring opposite elbow and knee together.
strings.exercise.bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
strings.exercise.bicycle_crunch.step1: Lie on your back with your hands by your ears.
strings.exercise.bicycle_crunch.step2: Bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
strings.exercise.bicycle_crunch.step3: Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
strings.exercise.bird_dog.alt: A person on hands and knees reaching one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
strings.exercise.bird_dog.cue: Reach one arm and the opposite leg out long.
strings.exercise.bird_dog.name: Bird dog
strings.exercise.bird_dog.step1: Start on hands and knees with your back flat.
strings.exercise.bird_dog.step2: Reach your right arm forward and your left leg back.
strings.exercise.bird_dog.step3: Hold, then switch. Keep your hips level.
strings.exercise.bollywood_clap_step.alt: A person stepping forward and clapping hands overhead.
strings.exercise.bollywood_clap_step.name: Clap step
strings.exercise.bollywood_clap_step.step1: Take two steps forward on the beat.
strings.exercise.bollywood_clap_step.step3: Step back and repeat with a big smile.
strings.exercise.box_step.alt: A person stepping in a small square pattern.
strings.exercise.box_step.cue: Step in a square: forward, side, back, together.
strings.exercise.box_step.name: Box step
strings.exercise.box_step.step1: Step your right foot forward and your left foot out to the side.
strings.exercise.box_step.step2: Step your right foot back and bring your feet together.
strings.exercise.box_step.step3: Repeat, starting with your left foot.
strings.exercise.calf_raise.alt: A person rising onto their toes.
strings.exercise.calf_raise.cue: Rise onto your toes and lower slowly.
strings.exercise.calf_raise.name: Calf raise
strings.exercise.calf_raise.step1: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
strings.exercise.calf_raise.step3: Lower your heels slowly. Hold a wall if you need balance.
strings.exercise.cat_cow.alt: A person on hands and knees, back dipped with chest lifted.
strings.exercise.cat_cow.cue: Arch and round your back with your breath.
strings.exercise.cat_cow.name: Cat and cow
strings.exercise.cat_cow.step1: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
strings.exercise.cat_cow.step2: Breathe in and lift your chest and tailbone.
strings.exercise.cat_cow.step3: Breathe out and round your back towards the ceiling.
strings.exercise.chair_pose.alt: A person in a seated-in-the-air pose with arms overhead.
strings.exercise.chair_pose.cue: Sit back as if into a chair and reach up.
strings.exercise.chair_pose.name: Chair pose
strings.exercise.chair_pose.step2: Bend your knees and sit your hips back.
strings.exercise.chair_pose.step3: Reach your arms overhead and breathe.
strings.exercise.chair_squat.alt: A person lowering their hips towards a chair behind them.
strings.exercise.chair_squat.cue: Sit back towards a chair, then stand up.
strings.exercise.chair_squat.name: Chair squat
strings.exercise.chair_squat.step1: Stand in front of a sturdy chair with your feet hip-width apart.
strings.exercise.chair_squat.step2: Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the seat.
strings.exercise.chair_squat.step3: Press through your feet to stand up.
strings.exercise.chest_opener.alt: A person standing with hands clasped behind the back and chest lifted.
strings.exercise.chest_opener.cue: Clasp your hands behind you and open your chest.
strings.exercise.chest_opener.name: Chest opener
strings.exercise.chest_opener.step2: Clasp your hands behind your back.
strings.exercise.chest_opener.step3: Straighten your arms, lift your chest and breathe.
strings.exercise.childs_pose.alt: A person kneeling, folded forward with arms stretched ahead.
strings.exercise.childs_pose.cue: Sit back on your heels and rest.
strings.exercise.childs_pose.name: Child's pose
strings.exercise.childs_pose.step1: Kneel and sit your hips back towards your heels.
strings.exercise.childs_pose.step2: Walk your hands forward and rest your forehead down.
strings.exercise.cobra_pose.alt: A person lying face down with the chest lifted.
strings.exercise.cobra_pose.cue: Lift your chest and keep your elbows soft.
strings.exercise.cobra_pose.name: Cobra pose
strings.exercise.cobra_pose.step1: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
strings.exercise.cobra_pose.step2: Press gently and lift your chest.
strings.exercise.cobra_pose.step3: Keep your legs relaxed and your neck long.
strings.exercise.crunch.alt: A person on their back curling the shoulders off the floor.
strings.exercise.crunch.cue: Curl your shoulders up a little and lower slowly.
strings.exercise.crunch.name: Crunch
strings.exercise.crunch.step1: Lie on your back with your knees bent and hands by your ears.
strings.exercise.crunch.step2: Curl your shoulders off the floor.
strings.exercise.crunch.step3: Lower slowly. Keep your neck relaxed.
strings.exercise.dead_bug.alt: A person on their back extending the opposite arm and leg.
strings.exercise.dead_bug.cue: Lower opposite arm and leg while your back stays flat.
strings.exercise.dead_bug.name: Dead bug
strings.exercise.dead_bug.step1: Lie on your back with your arms up and knees bent over your hips.
strings.exercise.dead_bug.step2: Lower your right arm and left leg towards the floor.
strings.exercise.dead_bug.step3: Return and switch sides. Keep your lower back flat.
strings.exercise.diamond_pushup.alt: A person doing a push-up with hands close together.
strings.exercise.diamond_pushup.cue: Hands close together, elbows tucked in.
strings.exercise.diamond_pushup.name: Close-hand push-up
strings.exercise.diamond_pushup.step1: Start in a high plank with your hands close together under your chest.
strings.exercise.diamond_pushup.step2: Lower with your elbows close to your sides.
strings.exercise.diamond_pushup.step3: Press back up in one straight line.
strings.exercise.donkey_kick.alt: A person on hands and knees with one bent leg lifted behind them.
strings.exercise.donkey_kick.cue: On hands and knees, press one heel up to the ceiling.
strings.exercise.donkey_kick.name: Donkey kick
strings.exercise.donkey_kick.step1: Start on hands and knees with your back flat.
strings.exercise.donkey_kick.step2: Lift one leg with your knee bent, heel towards the ceiling.
strings.exercise.donkey_kick.step3: Lower with control and keep your hips level.
strings.exercise.downward_dog.alt: A person in an upside-down V with hips high.
strings.exercise.downward_dog.cue: Lift your hips and lengthen your back.
strings.exercise.downward_dog.name: Downward dog
strings.exercise.downward_dog.step2: Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
strings.exercise.downward_dog.step3: Press your hands into the floor and breathe.
strings.exercise.figure_four.alt: A person sitting with one ankle on the opposite knee, leaning forward.
strings.exercise.figure_four.cue: Cross an ankle over your knee and lean forward.
strings.exercise.figure_four.name: Figure-four stretch
strings.exercise.figure_four.step2: Cross your right ankle over your left knee.
strings.exercise.figure_four.step3: Lean forward with a long back until you feel a stretch, then switch.
strings.exercise.fire_hydrant.alt: A person on hands and knees with one knee lifted out to the side.
strings.exercise.fire_hydrant.cue: On hands and knees, lift one knee out to the side.
strings.exercise.fire_hydrant.name: Fire hydrant
strings.exercise.fire_hydrant.step1: Start on hands and knees with your back flat.
strings.exercise.fire_hydrant.step2: Lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent.
strings.exercise.fire_hydrant.step3: Lower slowly and keep your hips steady.
strings.exercise.forearm_plank.alt: A person holding a plank on their forearms.
strings.exercise.forearm_plank.cue: Rest on your forearms and hold a straight line.
strings.exercise.forearm_plank.name: Forearm plank
strings.exercise.forearm_plank.step1: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
strings.exercise.forearm_plank.step2: Step your feet back so your body is one line.
strings.exercise.glute_bridge.alt: A person lying on their back with hips lifted in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
strings.exercise.glute_bridge.cue: Press your hips up and squeeze.
strings.exercise.glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
strings.exercise.glute_bridge.step1: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
strings.exercise.glute_bridge.step2: Press through your heels and lift your hips.
strings.exercise.glute_bridge.step3: Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower slowly.
strings.exercise.grapevine.alt: A person dancing a side step with the back foot crossing behind.
strings.exercise.grapevine.cue: Step out, cross behind, step out, tap.
strings.exercise.grapevine.name: Grapevine
strings.exercise.grapevine.step1: Step your right foot out to the side.
strings.exercise.grapevine.step2: Cross your left foot behind, then step out again.
strings.exercise.grapevine.step3: Tap your feet together and go back the other way.
strings.exercise.hamstring_stretch.alt: A person sitting with one leg straight, reaching forward.
strings.exercise.hamstring_stretch.cue: Reach towards your toes with a long back.
strings.exercise.hamstring_stretch.name: Hamstring stretch
strings.exercise.hamstring_stretch.step1: Sit tall with one leg straight and the other bent.
strings.exercise.hamstring_stretch.step2: Reach gently towards your straight foot.
strings.exercise.hamstring_stretch.step3: Hold and breathe, then switch legs.
strings.exercise.high_knees.alt: A person running on the spot with one knee driven high.
strings.exercise.high_knees.cue: Run on the spot and lift your knees high.
strings.exercise.high_knees.name: High knees
strings.exercise.high_knees.step1: Stand tall with your arms bent.
strings.exercise.high_knees.step2: Run on the spot and drive each knee up towards your hips.
strings.exercise.high_knees.step3: Stay light on your feet and keep your chest up.
strings.exercise.hip_circles.alt: A person standing with hands on the waist, hips drawing a circle.
strings.exercise.hip_circles.cue: Move your hips in a slow, wide circle.
strings.exercise.hip_circles.name: Hip circles
strings.exercise.hip_circles.step1: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips and hands on your waist.
strings.exercise.hip_circles.step2: Draw a slow circle with your hips.
strings.exercise.hip_sway.alt: A person standing and swaying the hips from side to side.
strings.exercise.hip_sway.cue: Sway your hips from side to side with the beat.
strings.exercise.hip_sway.name: Hip sway
strings.exercise.hip_sway.step1: Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips.
strings.exercise.hip_sway.step2: Shift your weight and push your hips to the right.
strings.exercise.hip_sway.step3: Sway to the left and let your arms move freely.
strings.exercise.hollow_hold.alt: A person on their back holding arms and legs just above the floor.
strings.exercise.hollow_hold.cue: Hold with your arms and legs long above the floor.
strings.exercise.hollow_hold.name: Hollow hold
strings.exercise.hollow_hold.step1: Lie on your back with your arms overhead.
strings.exercise.hollow_hold.step2: Lift your shoulders and legs a little off the floor.
strings.exercise.hollow_hold.step3: Keep your lower back pressed down and hold.
strings.exercise.inchworm.alt: A person folding forward and walking their hands out into a long plank shape.
strings.exercise.inchworm.cue: Walk your hands out, then walk them back.
strings.exercise.inchworm.name: Inchworm
strings.exercise.inchworm.step1: Stand tall, then fold forward with soft knees.
strings.exercise.inchworm.step2: Walk your hands out until your body is in a long line.
strings.exercise.inchworm.step3: Walk your hands back and stand up slowly.
strings.exercise.jump_squat.alt: A person leaping up from a squat with arms swung overhead.
strings.exercise.jump_squat.cue: Squat down, then jump and land softly.
strings.exercise.jump_squat.name: Jump squat
strings.exercise.jump_squat.step1: Lower into a squat with your arms back.
strings.exercise.jump_squat.step2: Jump up and swing your arms forward.
strings.exercise.jump_squat.step3: Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next one.
strings.exercise.jumping_jacks.alt: A person mid jumping jack with feet wide and arms overhead.
strings.exercise.jumping_jacks.cue: Jump your feet wide and clap overhead.
strings.exercise.jumping_jacks.name: Jumping jacks
strings.exercise.jumping_jacks.step1: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
strings.exercise.jumping_jacks.step2: Jump your feet wide and raise your arms overhead.
strings.exercise.jumping_jacks.step3: Jump back to the start and keep a steady rhythm.
strings.exercise.knee_plank.alt: A person holding a plank with knees down.
strings.exercise.knee_plank.cue: Hold a plank with your knees on the floor.
strings.exercise.knee_plank.name: Knee plank
strings.exercise.knee_plank.step1: Place your hands under your shoulders and kneel.
strings.exercise.knee_plank.step2: Make a straight line from head to knees.
strings.exercise.knee_pushup.alt: A person doing a push-up with knees on the floor.
strings.exercise.knee_pushup.cue: Lower your chest with your knees on the floor.
strings.exercise.knee_pushup.name: Knee push-up
strings.exercise.knee_pushup.step1: Start on hands and knees, hands under your shoulders.
strings.exercise.knee_pushup.step2: Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the floor.
strings.exercise.knee_pushup.step3: Press back up, keeping a straight line from head to knees.
strings.exercise.low_skater.alt: A person stepping sideways with the back leg sweeping behind, both feet staying near the floor.
strings.exercise.low_skater.cue: Step side to side and sweep your back leg.
strings.exercise.low_skater.name: Low-impact skater
strings.exercise.low_skater.step1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
strings.exercise.low_skater.step2: Step to the right and sweep your left leg behind you.
strings.exercise.low_skater.step3: Step to the left and sweep your right leg behind you.
strings.exercise.lunge.alt: A person in a forward lunge with both knees bent.
strings.exercise.lunge.cue: Step forward and lower, then push back.
strings.exercise.lunge.name: Forward lunge
strings.exercise.lunge.step1: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
strings.exercise.lunge.step2: Step forward and lower until both knees bend.
strings.exercise.lunge.step3: Push off your front foot to return, then switch.
strings.exercise.march_in_place.alt: A person marching on the spot with one knee raised.
strings.exercise.march_in_place.cue: Lift your knees and swing your arms.
strings.exercise.march_in_place.name: March in place
strings.exercise.march_in_place.step1: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
strings.exercise.march_in_place.step2: Lift one knee, then the other, at an easy pace.
strings.exercise.march_in_place.step3: Swing your arms and breathe steadily.
strings.exercise.mountain_climbers.alt: A person in a high plank bringing one knee towards the chest.
strings.exercise.mountain_climbers.cue: From a plank, drive your knees in one at a time.
strings.exercise.mountain_climbers.name: Mountain climbers
strings.exercise.mountain_climbers.step1: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
strings.exercise.mountain_climbers.step2: Bring one knee towards your chest.
strings.exercise.mountain_climbers.step3: Switch legs at a pace you can keep steady.
strings.exercise.mountain_pose.alt: A person standing tall with arms relaxed by their sides.
strings.exercise.mountain_pose.cue: Stand tall, breathe in for four, out for six.
strings.exercise.mountain_pose.name: Mountain pose
strings.exercise.mountain_pose.step1: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
strings.exercise.mountain_pose.step2: Grow tall through the top of your head.
strings.exercise.mountain_pose.step3: Breathe in for four and out for six.
strings.exercise.neck_release.alt: A person sitting tall with the head tilted towards one shoulder.
strings.exercise.neck_release.cue: Tilt your ear towards your shoulder.
strings.exercise.neck_release.name: Neck release
strings.exercise.neck_release.step1: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
strings.exercise.neck_release.step2: Tilt your right ear towards your right shoulder.
strings.exercise.pike_pushup.alt: A person in an upside-down V bending the elbows.
strings.exercise.pike_pushup.cue: Hips high, lower your head towards the floor.
strings.exercise.pike_pushup.name: Pike push-up
strings.exercise.pike_pushup.step1: Start with your hips high in an upside-down V.
strings.exercise.pike_pushup.step2: Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head towards the floor.
strings.exercise.pike_pushup.step3: Press back up to the V.
strings.exercise.plank.alt: A person holding a high plank.
strings.exercise.plank.cue: Hold one straight line from head to heels.
strings.exercise.plank.name: Plank
strings.exercise.plank.step1: Place your hands under your shoulders and step your feet back.
strings.exercise.plank.step2: Squeeze your tummy and glutes so your body is one line.
strings.exercise.pushup.alt: A person doing a full push-up.
strings.exercise.pushup.cue: Lower as one straight line and press back up.
strings.exercise.pushup.name: Push-up
strings.exercise.pushup.step1: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
strings.exercise.pushup.step2: Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the floor.
strings.exercise.pushup.step3: Press back up, keeping your body in one line.
strings.exercise.quad_stretch.alt: A person standing on one leg holding the opposite ankle behind them.
strings.exercise.quad_stretch.cue: Hold your ankle and ease your heel towards your hip.
strings.exercise.quad_stretch.name: Standing quad stretch
strings.exercise.quad_stretch.step1: Stand tall and hold a wall if you like.
strings.exercise.quad_stretch.step2: Bend one knee and hold your ankle.
strings.exercise.quad_stretch.step3: Keep your knees together and hold, then switch.
strings.exercise.reverse_crunch.alt: A person on their back curling the hips off the floor.
strings.exercise.reverse_crunch.cue: Curl your knees in towards your chest.
strings.exercise.reverse_crunch.name: Reverse crunch
strings.exercise.reverse_crunch.step1: Lie on your back with your knees bent over your hips.
strings.exercise.reverse_crunch.step2: Curl your hips up a little and bring your knees towards your chest.
strings.exercise.reverse_lunge.alt: A person stepping one foot back into a lunge.
strings.exercise.reverse_lunge.cue: Step back and lower, then return.
strings.exercise.reverse_lunge.name: Reverse lunge
strings.exercise.reverse_lunge.step1: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
strings.exercise.reverse_lunge.step2: Step one foot back and lower your back knee.
strings.exercise.reverse_lunge.step3: Press through your front foot to return, then switch.
strings.exercise.russian_twist.alt: A person sitting and leaning back, turning the chest to one side.
strings.exercise.russian_twist.cue: Lean back a little and turn from side to side.
strings.exercise.russian_twist.name: Seated twist
strings.exercise.russian_twist.step1: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
strings.exercise.russian_twist.step2: Turn your chest and hands to one side.
strings.exercise.russian_twist.step3: Turn to the other side. Keep your back long.
strings.exercise.seated_twist.alt: A person sitting and turning the upper body to one side.
strings.exercise.seated_twist.cue: Turn gently and hold the back of your chair.
strings.exercise.seated_twist.name: Desk twist
strings.exercise.seated_twist.step1: Sit tall with both feet on the floor.
strings.exercise.seated_twist.step2: Turn your chest to the right and hold the chair back.
strings.exercise.seated_twist.step3: Breathe, then turn to the other side.
strings.exercise.shadow_boxing.alt: A person with fists raised, punching forward with one arm.
strings.exercise.shadow_boxing.cue: Throw light punches in the air.
strings.exercise.shadow_boxing.name: Shadow boxing
strings.exercise.shadow_boxing.step1: Stand with your feet apart and fists up by your chin.
strings.exercise.shadow_boxing.step2: Punch forward with one arm, then the other.
strings.exercise.shadow_boxing.step3: Turn your body a little with each punch and keep your elbows soft.
strings.exercise.shoulder_blade_squeeze.alt: A person sitting tall with elbows drawn back.
strings.exercise.shoulder_blade_squeeze.name: Shoulder blade squeeze
strings.exercise.shoulder_blade_squeeze.step1: Sit tall with your arms by your sides.
strings.exercise.shoulder_blade_squeeze.step2: Draw your shoulder blades back and together.
strings.exercise.shoulder_blade_squeeze.step3: Hold for a breath, then let go.
strings.exercise.shoulder_rolls.alt: A person standing with relaxed arms, shoulders rolling back.
strings.exercise.shoulder_rolls.cue: Lift, roll back and let go.
strings.exercise.shoulder_rolls.name: Shoulder rolls
strings.exercise.shoulder_rolls.step1: Stand or sit tall with your arms relaxed.
strings.exercise.shoulder_rolls.step2: Lift your shoulders towards your ears.
strings.exercise.shoulder_rolls.step3: Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
strings.exercise.shoulder_taps.alt: A person in a plank tapping one shoulder with the opposite hand.
strings.exercise.shoulder_taps.cue: In a plank, tap one shoulder at a time.
strings.exercise.shoulder_taps.name: Shoulder taps
strings.exercise.shoulder_taps.step1: Start in a high plank with your feet a little wider than your hips.
strings.exercise.shoulder_taps.step2: Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
strings.exercise.shoulder_taps.step3: Return it and switch. Keep your hips still.
strings.exercise.side_lunge.alt: A person lunging sideways with one leg bent and the other straight.
strings.exercise.side_lunge.cue: Step wide and sit back over one leg.
strings.exercise.side_lunge.name: Side lunge
strings.exercise.side_lunge.step2: Step out to the side and push your hips back over that leg.
strings.exercise.side_lunge.step3: Push off to return, then switch sides.
strings.exercise.side_plank.alt: A person balancing on one forearm with the body in a straight line.
strings.exercise.side_plank.cue: Balance on one arm with your body in a line.
strings.exercise.side_plank.name: Side plank
strings.exercise.side_plank.step1: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
strings.exercise.side_plank.step2: Lift your hips so you make a straight line.
strings.exercise.single_leg_bridge.alt: A person in a bridge with one leg extended in the air.
strings.exercise.single_leg_bridge.cue: Lift one leg and press up with the other.
strings.exercise.single_leg_bridge.name: Single-leg bridge
strings.exercise.single_leg_bridge.step1: Lie on your back with your knees bent and one leg lifted.
strings.exercise.single_leg_bridge.step2: Press through the planted heel and lift your hips.
strings.exercise.skater_hop.alt: A person hopping sideways onto one leg with the other leg swept behind.
strings.exercise.skater_hop.cue: Hop side to side and land softly.
strings.exercise.skater_hop.name: Skater hops
strings.exercise.skater_hop.step1: Stand on one leg with the other leg behind you.
strings.exercise.skater_hop.step2: Hop sideways onto the other leg and swing your arms.
strings.exercise.skater_hop.step3: Land softly with a slightly bent knee.
strings.exercise.squat.alt: A person in a squat, thighs close to parallel, arms forward.
strings.exercise.squat.cue: Sit your hips back and keep your knees in line with your toes.
strings.exercise.squat.name: Squat
strings.exercise.squat.step1: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
strings.exercise.squat.step2: Push your hips back and bend your knees, chest up.
strings.exercise.squat.step3: Press through your whole foot to stand.
strings.exercise.step_jacks.alt: A person stepping one foot out to the side with arms raised overhead.
strings.exercise.step_jacks.cue: Step out wide with no jumping.
strings.exercise.step_jacks.name: Step jacks
strings.exercise.step_jacks.step2: Step one foot out wide and raise your arms overhead.
strings.exercise.step_jacks.step3: Step back in and lower your arms, then switch sides.
strings.exercise.step_touch.alt: A person stepping to the side with arms swinging gently.
strings.exercise.step_touch.cue: Step to the side and tap your feet together on the beat.
strings.exercise.step_touch.name: Step touch
strings.exercise.step_touch.step1: Step your right foot out to the side.
strings.exercise.step_touch.step2: Bring your left foot to meet it with a tap.
strings.exercise.step_touch.step3: Repeat to the left, and add arm swings.
strings.exercise.sumo_squat.alt: A person in a wide-stance squat with toes turned out.
strings.exercise.sumo_squat.cue: Take a wide stance and lower straight down.
strings.exercise.sumo_squat.name: Wide squat
strings.exercise.sumo_squat.step1: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
strings.exercise.sumo_squat.step2: Bend your knees and lower straight down.
strings.exercise.sumo_squat.step3: Squeeze your glutes as you stand.
strings.exercise.superman.alt: A person lying face down with arms and legs lifted.
strings.exercise.superman.cue: Lie on your tummy and lift your arms and legs a little.
strings.exercise.superman.name: Superman
strings.exercise.superman.step1: Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front.
strings.exercise.superman.step2: Lift your arms, chest and legs a little off the floor.
strings.exercise.superman.step3: Hold for a breath, then lower slowly.
strings.exercise.torso_twist.alt: A person standing and twisting the upper body to one side with arms swinging.
strings.exercise.torso_twist.cue: Turn from your middle and let your arms swing.
strings.exercise.torso_twist.name: Standing twist
strings.exercise.torso_twist.step1: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and arms loose.
strings.exercise.torso_twist.step2: Turn your chest to the right and let your arms follow.
strings.exercise.torso_twist.step3: Turn to the left. Keep your hips facing front.
strings.exercise.tree_pose.alt: A person balancing on one leg with the other foot on the calf and hands at the chest.
strings.exercise.tree_pose.cue: Balance on one leg and rest your other foot on your calf.
strings.exercise.tree_pose.name: Tree pose
strings.exercise.tree_pose.step1: Stand tall and shift your weight to your left foot.
strings.exercise.tree_pose.step2: Place your right foot on your calf or thigh, never on the knee.
strings.exercise.tree_pose.step3: Bring your hands together at your chest and breathe.
strings.exercise.wall_pushup.alt: A person leaning into a wall with bent elbows.
strings.exercise.wall_pushup.cue: Push away from the wall and come back.
strings.exercise.wall_pushup.name: Wall push-up
strings.exercise.wall_pushup.step1: Stand an arm's length from a wall with your hands on it.
strings.exercise.wall_pushup.step2: Bend your elbows and bring your chest towards the wall.
strings.exercise.wall_sit.alt: A person sitting against a wall with no chair, knees bent.
strings.exercise.wall_sit.cue: Slide down the wall and hold.
strings.exercise.wall_sit.name: Wall sit
strings.exercise.wall_sit.step1: Lean your back on a wall and walk your feet forward.
strings.exercise.wall_sit.step2: Slide down until your knees are bent, as low as is comfortable.
strings.exercise.warrior_ii.alt: A person in warrior two with arms stretched to both sides.
strings.exercise.warrior_ii.cue: Wide stance, front knee bent, arms long.
strings.exercise.warrior_ii.name: Warrior two
strings.exercise.warrior_ii.step1: Step your feet wide apart and turn your right foot out.
strings.exercise.warrior_ii.step2: Bend your right knee over your ankle and stretch your arms wide.
strings.exercise.warrior_ii.step3: Look over your front hand and breathe, then switch sides.
strings.exercise.wrist_stretch.alt: A person sitting with one arm extended and the other hand easing the fingers back.
strings.exercise.wrist_stretch.cue: Stretch your arm out and ease your fingers back.
strings.exercise.wrist_stretch.name: Wrist stretch
strings.exercise.wrist_stretch.step1: Stretch your right arm out in front with the palm up.
strings.exercise.wrist_stretch.step2: Use your other hand to gently ease your fingers down.

strings.formcue.lunge.balance: Slow down and find your balance.
strings.formcue.lunge.front_knee: Keep your front knee over your ankle.
strings.formcue.pushup.depth: Lower a little more if it is comfortable.
strings.formcue.squat.depth: Go a little lower if it feels fine.
strings.learn.concept.effort_talk_test.p1: Effort is how hard a move feels to you, not how it looks. A simple check is the talk test.
strings.learn.concept.effort_talk_test.p2: If you can talk in full sentences, you are at an easy effort. If you can say a few words at a time, that is a good working effort. If you can only gasp single words, ease off.
strings.learn.concept.effort_talk_test.p3: Most of your work minutes should feel like the middle one. If a move feels too easy or too hard, use the easier or harder option on the screen.
strings.learn.concept.effort_talk_test.take: Aim for short sentences, not full speeches and not single gasps.
strings.learn.concept.effort_talk_test.title: How hard is hard enough
strings.learn.concept.form_before_speed.p1: Good form means moving the way a move is meant to be done. It puts the work in the right muscles and keeps your joints comfortable.
strings.learn.concept.form_before_speed.p2: Slow down until the move feels steady. Use an easier version if you need to. Going faster with loose form does not make the move better.
strings.learn.concept.form_before_speed.p3: Form check uses your camera to give one cue at a time. The video stays on your phone and is never uploaded.
strings.learn.concept.form_before_speed.take: A slower, steadier rep beats a rushed one.
strings.learn.concept.form_before_speed.title: Form before speed
strings.learn.concept.label: Concept
strings.learn.concept.protein_basics.p1: Protein helps your body repair and keep muscle. You can get it from dal, curd, paneer, eggs, fish, chicken, soya and sprouts.
strings.learn.concept.protein_basics.p2: Spreading it across your meals is easier than eating it all at once. A katori of dal, a bowl of curd or two eggs each add a useful amount.
strings.learn.concept.protein_basics.p3: Your daily target in the app is a starting point, not a test. Use it to notice patterns, then adjust with a dietitian if you need to.
strings.learn.concept.protein_basics.take: A little protein at each meal adds up.
strings.learn.concept.protein_basics.title: Protein in plain words
strings.learn.concept.rest_and_recovery.p1: Your body gets stronger while you rest, not while you move. Rest days give muscles and joints time to recover.
strings.learn.concept.rest_and_recovery.p2: That is why your week has gaps. On a rest day you can walk, stretch or do nothing at all. All of those are fine.
strings.learn.concept.rest_and_recovery.p3: If you feel very tired or sore, taking an extra rest day is a smart choice.
strings.learn.concept.rest_and_recovery.take: Rest is when the work pays off.
strings.learn.concept.rest_and_recovery.title: Rest days are part of the plan
strings.learn.concept.small_sessions_add_up.p1: A short session you finish is worth more than a long one you skip. Fifteen minutes fits between work, school and family.
strings.learn.concept.small_sessions_add_up.p2: Over a week, four sessions add up to an hour of movement. Over a month it becomes a habit that is easier to keep.
strings.learn.concept.small_sessions_add_up.p3: If you miss a day, nothing is lost. Pick up the next session whenever you are ready.
strings.learn.concept.small_sessions_add_up.take: Come back whenever you can. Progress waits for you.
strings.learn.concept.sore_or_hurt.p1: Soreness is a dull, spread-out ache in a muscle. It often shows up a day after a new or harder session and fades in a few days.
strings.learn.concept.sore_or_hurt.p2: Pain is different. It can be sharp, pinching, burning or sit in a joint. It may come on during a move or get worse as you go.
strings.learn.concept.sore_or_hurt.p3: If something hurts, stop, pick an easier move and give it time. If pain stays or you feel unsure, please talk to a doctor or physiotherapist.
strings.learn.concept.sore_or_hurt.take: A dull ache can be fine. Sharp or joint pain is a stop sign.
strings.learn.concept.sore_or_hurt.title: Sore or hurt: how to tell
strings.learn.concept.steps_vs_workouts.p1: Steps keep you moving through the day. They help your heart, your mood and your energy, and they add up quietly.
strings.learn.concept.steps_vs_workouts.p2: A workout is a short, focused effort that challenges your muscles and your breathing. It builds strength and fitness in a way walking alone may not.
strings.learn.concept.steps_vs_workouts.p3: You do not have to pick one. A few brisk walks and a 15-minute session on most days work well together.
strings.learn.concept.steps_vs_workouts.take: Walk to stay moving, train to get stronger.
strings.learn.concept.steps_vs_workouts.title: Steps and workouts do different jobs
strings.learn.concept.warm_up.p1: A warm-up raises your heart rate slowly and gets your joints moving. Your muscles feel looser and ready for the work ahead.
strings.learn.concept.warm_up.p2: In CasaFit the first two minutes of every 15-minute session are a warm-up. The moves are gentle and match what you will do next, so your legs warm up before leg work and your shoulders before arm work.
strings.learn.concept.warm_up.p3: You can skip it on a day when time is short, but we suggest keeping it. Two minutes is a small price for a smoother session.
strings.learn.concept.warm_up.take: Two easy minutes first make the hard minutes feel better.
strings.learn.concept.warm_up.title: Why we warm up
strings.learn.myth.cardio_only.evidence: Strength training and nutrition both contribute alongside cardio to body composition.
strings.learn.myth.cardio_only.title: Cardio is the only way to lose weight
strings.learn.myth.cardio_only.true: Cardio helps, but strength work and what you eat matter too. A mix is easier to stick with, and stronger muscles support your joints.
strings.learn.myth.crunches_belly_fat.evidence: In a six-week trial, people who trained their abdominal muscles did not lose more belly fat than before.
strings.learn.myth.crunches_belly_fat.title: Crunches burn belly fat
strings.learn.myth.crunches_belly_fat.true: Your body takes fat from all over, not only from the muscles you work. Crunches build core strength, but they do not melt fat from your tummy.
strings.learn.myth.fifteen_minutes_too_short.evi: Several trials of short exercise bouts, often called exercise snacks, found fitness gains with high adherence.
strings.learn.myth.fifteen_minutes_too_short.tit: 15 minutes is too short to matter
strings.learn.myth.fifteen_minutes_too_short.tru: Short bouts of activity improved fitness in people who were not active, and they kept at it more often than with long sessions. A session you actually do beats a long one you skip.
strings.learn.myth.label: Myth
strings.learn.myth.no_pain_no_gain.cta: See easier versions of a move
strings.learn.myth.no_pain_no_gain.evidence: Sharp pain during exercise is a warning sign of injury, not a sign of progress.
strings.learn.myth.no_pain_no_gain.title: No pain, no gain
strings.learn.myth.no_pain_no_gain.true: Tired, warm muscles and mild soreness a day later are normal. Sharp, pinching or joint pain is a signal to stop and pick an easier move.
strings.learn.myth.stretch_before_exercise.evide: Dynamic warm-ups improve readiness. Long static stretches before lifting can briefly reduce strength.
strings.learn.myth.stretch_before_exercise.title: Stretching before exercise prevents injury
strings.learn.myth.stretch_before_exercise.true: Moving warm-ups help you get ready. Holding long stretches right before a hard effort can briefly lower your strength, so save the long holds for the end of your session.
strings.learn.myth.sweat_burns_fat.evidence: Sweat rate reflects temperature control, not fat loss.
strings.learn.myth.sweat_burns_fat.title: Sweating more means burning more fat
strings.learn.myth.sweat_burns_fat.true: Sweat is how your body cools down. It depends on heat, humidity and your own body, and it does not measure how much fat you burn.
strings.learn.myth.ten_thousand_steps.evidence: A meta-analysis of daily steps and risk of death found benefits flattening out between about 6,000 and 8,000 steps for adults aged 60 and over, and a little higher for younger adults.
strings.learn.myth.ten_thousand_steps.title: You need 10,000 steps a day
strings.learn.myth.ten_thousand_steps.true: For most adults, health gains level off at around 7,000 steps a day. 10,000 is a fine goal if you enjoy it, but it is not a magic number.
strings.learn.myth.walking_backwards.evidence: Early studies are promising but limited in size.
strings.learn.myth.walking_backwards.title: Walking backwards is a miracle workout
strings.learn.myth.walking_backwards.true: Walking backwards looks promising for balance and knee comfort, but the studies so far are small. Enjoy it as a fun change, not a miracle.
strings.learn.myth.weights_bulky_women.evidence: Strength training improves body composition without a bulky look for most women.
strings.learn.myth.weights_bulky_women.title: Lifting weights makes women bulky
strings.learn.myth.weights_bulky_women.true: Women make much less testosterone than men, so building large muscles is slow and takes a lot of effort. Strength work mostly makes you stronger and changes your body shape gradually.
strings.learn.myth.yoga_dance_not_exercise.cta: Try a yoga or dance session
strings.learn.myth.yoga_dance_not_exercise.evide: Randomised trials of yoga and of Zumba-style dance report cardiovascular and body-composition gains.
strings.learn.myth.yoga_dance_not_exercise.title: Yoga and dance are not real exercise
strings.learn.myth.yoga_dance_not_exercise.true: Trials show that yoga and dance can both improve heart fitness and body composition. If you enjoy it and it raises your effort, it counts.
